issue: मुरछल चवँर लिएँ रामेस्वर — रामेस्वर may be the poet's signature (the poet bidding himself, as stanza 1 bids the companions with लिएँ … सुनाओ) or an address to Śiva (Rāmeśvara, the lord whom Rāma worships); the page alone does not say.
our reading: holding the peacock-feather fan and the whisk, Rāmeśvara (the poet's name), joyfully shower flowers
alternatives: O Rāmeśvara (Śiva), holding the fan and whisk, shower flowers with joy.
